author_book:
CREATE TABLE author_book (
	author_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	book_asin VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	book_region region_enum NOT NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(book_asin, book_region) REFERENCES books (asin, region) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_author_book UNIQUE (author_id, book_asin, book_region), 
	FOREIGN KEY(author_id) REFERENCES authors (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX book_author_index ON author_book (book_asin, author_id)
author_genre:
CREATE TABLE author_genre (
	author_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	genre_asin VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_author_genre UNIQUE (author_id, genre_asin), 
	FOREIGN KEY(author_id) REFERENCES authors (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(genre_asin) REFERENCES genres (asin) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX author_genre_index ON author_genre (genre_asin, author_id)
CREATE INDEX genre_author_index ON author_genre (author_id, genre_asin)
authors:
CREATE TABLE authors (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	asin VARCHAR(12), 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	region region_enum NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	image TEXT, 
	fetched_description BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	last_seeded_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	confirmed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT authors_asin_region_name_unique UNIQUE (asin, region, name)
)
CREATE INDEX authors_asin_region_name_index ON authors (asin, region, name)
CREATE INDEX authors_region_name_index ON authors (region, name)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_authors_name_region_null_asin ON authors (name, region) WHERE asin IS NULL
book_genre:
CREATE TABLE book_genre (
	book_asin VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	book_region region_enum NOT NULL, 
	genre_asin VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(book_asin, book_region) REFERENCES books (asin, region) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_book_genre UNIQUE (book_asin, book_region, genre_asin), 
	FOREIGN KEY(genre_asin) REFERENCES genres (asin) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX genre_book_index ON book_genre (genre_asin, book_asin, book_region)
book_narrator:
CREATE TABLE book_narrator (
	narrator_name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	book_asin VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	book_region region_enum NOT NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(book_asin, book_region) REFERENCES books (asin, region) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_book_narrator UNIQUE (book_asin, book_region, narrator_name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(narrator_name) REFERENCES narrators (name) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
book_series:
CREATE TABLE book_series (
	book_asin VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	book_region region_enum NOT NULL, 
	series_asin VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	series_region region_enum NOT NULL, 
	position VARCHAR(100), 
	FOREIGN KEY(book_asin, book_region) REFERENCES books (asin, region) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(series_asin, series_region) REFERENCES series (asin, region) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_book_series UNIQUE (book_asin, book_region, series_asin, series_region)
)
books:
CREATE TABLE books (
	asin VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	title TEXT NOT NULL, 
	subtitle TEXT, 
	region region_enum NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	summary TEXT, 
	publisher TEXT, 
	copyright TEXT, 
	isbn VARCHAR(16), 
	language VARCHAR(50), 
	rating DOUBLE PRECISION, 
	release_date TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	length_minutes INTEGER, 
	explicit BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	whisper_sync BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	has_pdf BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	image TEXT, 
	book_format VARCHAR(50), 
	content_type VARCHAR(100), 
	content_delivery_type VARCHAR(100), 
	episode_number VARCHAR(20), 
	episode_type VARCHAR(50), 
	sku VARCHAR(20), 
	sku_group VARCHAR(20), 
	is_listenable BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	is_buyable BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	is_vvab BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	plans JSONB, 
	num_ratings INTEGER, 
	num_reviews INTEGER, 
	publication_name TEXT, 
	publication_datetime TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	extended_product_description TEXT, 
	product_state TEXT, 
	audible_extras JSONB, 
	extras_withheld JSONB, 
	chapters_checked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	is_primary BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	confirmed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	chapters_confirmed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (asin, region)
)
CREATE INDEX books_region_asin_index ON books (region, asin)
genres:
CREATE TABLE genres (
	asin VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	type genre_type_enum NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (asin)
)
narrators:
CREATE TABLE narrators (
	name TEXT NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	image TEXT, 
	website TEXT, 
	wikipedia_url TEXT, 
	languages JSONB, 
	accents JSONB, 
	gender VARCHAR(20), 
	genres_narrated JSONB, 
	audiobooks_produced VARCHAR(50), 
	cultural_heritage TEXT, 
	publishers JSONB, 
	social_links JSONB, 
	audio_samples JSONB, 
	source TEXT, 
	source_url TEXT, 
	source_updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	fetched_description BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	last_seeded_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (name)
)
series:
CREATE TABLE series (
	asin VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	title TEXT NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	region region_enum NOT NULL, 
	fetched_description BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	last_seeded_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	confirmed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	is_primary BOOLEAN DEFAULT true NOT NULL, 
	audible_extras JSONB, 
	extras_withheld JSONB, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (asin, region)
)
CREATE INDEX series_region_index ON series (region)
series_author:
CREATE TABLE series_author (
	series_asin VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	series_region region_enum NOT NULL, 
	author_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(series_asin, series_region) REFERENCES series (asin, region) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_series_author UNIQUE (series_asin, series_region, author_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(author_id) REFERENCES authors (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX author_series_index ON series_author (author_id, series_asin)
tracks:
CREATE TABLE tracks (
	asin VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	region region_enum NOT NULL, 
	chapters JSONB NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (asin, region), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asin, region) REFERENCES books (asin, region) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
walk_results:
CREATE TABLE walk_results (
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	asin VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	region region_enum NOT NULL, 
	complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	incomplete_reasons JSONB NOT NULL, 
	book_asins JSONB NOT NULL, 
	confirmed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (kind, asin, region), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_walk_results_kind CHECK (kind IN ('author_books', 'series_books'))
)
